evidence.quote: With per query billing, you can save 30% to 90% per query and get better performance by compressing, partitioning, and converting your data into columnar formats. Each of these operations reduces the amount of data scanned and time required for execution. These operations are also recommended when using Capacity Reservations, because they often reduce the amount of time a query spends executing.
